validation: Rebuilt from the deleted TP4 profile (git e2e355d) at TP1 on one B300: apetersson/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-Abliterated-FP8 @ revision 7d02640c72a2c8127f116d3d1933ddfec5e4c0fa, 48 safetensors shards totalling 155.4 GiB (FP8 e4m3 dynamic, expert_dtype fp4), architecture DeepseekV4ForCausalLM (deepseek_v4): 43 layers, MLA-style attention (num_key_value_heads 1, head_dim 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64, q/o_lora_rank 1024) with sparse indexing (index_topk 512) and sliding_window 128, MoE 256 routed experts / 6 per token / 1 shared, num_nextn_predict_layers=1, native context 1048576 capped at 524288 as in the TP4 profile. TP1 sizing on a 268 GiB B300 at gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 (~241 GiB): 155.4 GiB weights leave ~86 GiB for the compressed KV — enough for 524288-token sequences, but max-num-seqs is cut from the TP4 profile's 8 to 4 so worst-case concurrent sequences cannot overrun the pool (TP4 had ~4x the KV headroom). --enable-expert-parallel is dropped (EP only sharded at TP>1) and dtype stays bfloat16 for the non-quantized tail, as before. Parser candidates unchanged (deepseek_v4/v41/v3/v31): the launcher resolves them from the image's registry and appends --enable-auto-tool-choice. NOT yet GPU-validated at TP1; trust it only after a first READY endpoint and its chat_tools checks.
